meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把计划或讨论拆成可追踪的工单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将需求或讨论转化为可执行的工单
copy.tagline_en: Break plans or discussions into trackable tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn requirements or discussions into actionable tickets

howto.what: Claude可将计划、需求或对话拆成垂直切片工单，每个工单标注阻塞依赖，并发布到配置的跟踪器（本地文件或真实Issue系统），按依赖顺序从01开始编号。
howto.when: 当用户请求拆分计划、需求或对话时触发。用户可提供引用（如spec路径、Issue编号或URL）作为输入。

say.text: 把我的项目计划拆成工单。
say.note: 将计划分解为工单并发布。

say.text: 将这份功能规格分解为可执行的工单。
say.note: 分析规格文档，生成工单列表。

say.text: 分析当前讨论，生成工单并发布到GitHub。
say.note: 根据对话内容生成工单。

howto.what_en: Claude can break a plan, spec, or conversation into vertical-slice tickets, each declaring its blocking edges. Tickets are numbered in dependency order and published to the configured tracker (local files or real issue tracker).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to decompose a plan, spec, or conversation into tickets, optionally supplying a reference (spec path, issue number or URL).

say_en.text: Break my project plan into tickets.
Decompose this feature spec into actionable tickets.
say_en.note: Generates a ticket breakdown from the spec.

say_en.text: Analyze our discussion and create tickets on GitHub.
